name: Financial Assistance To Gad-Hanjis
benefit:
The financial assistance for the purchase of Nylon Twine will be sanctioned at the following rates:
1. License holders having paid fee of ₹ 50/-: ₹ 500/-.
2. License holders having paid fee of ₹ 40/-: ₹ 400/-.
3. License holders having paid fee of ₹ 30/-: ₹ 300/-.
4. License holders having paid fee of ₹ 20/-: ₹ 200/-.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India.
1. The applicant should be a Gad-Hanji (Fisherman) licensed by the Fisheries Department consecutively for the last 3 years.
1. The annual income of the applicant should not exceed ₹ 3,600/-.
1. The applicant should not have received assistance under this scheme during the last 2 years.
